lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，我用速度弥补精度的不足。
lines.en: Sssss, speed makes up for my poor accuracy.

lines.zh: 我的长腿让我能在岛上迅速移动。
lines.en: My long legs allow me to move quickly.

lines.zh: 这块肉不够好吃，但可以填饱肚子。
lines.en: This meat is not tasty, but it’ll do.

lines.zh: 我在这片岛屿上独占一方天地。
lines.en: I claim this island for myself.

lines.zh: 用盾牌防住，我会被震晕的。
lines.en: Block me, and I'll be dazed.
Companions pose a threat to my survival.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛帮助我捕捉猎物的动静。
lines.en: My eyes help me spot prey.

lines.zh: 生杯龙肉是罕见但美味的食物。
lines.en: Raw Cupreodraco meat is rare but delicious.

lines.zh: 长腿一蹬，我冲过碎石坡。
lines.en: One kick of these long legs and I cross the scree.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔喷着热气，赶向腥味。
lines.en: My nostrils snort steam as I head for the scent of blood.

lines.zh: 岛上没人和我抢这条路。
lines.en: No one on this island contests this path with me.

lines.zh: 我踩着同类的旧骨走过去。
lines.en: I walk over an old kin's bones.
I wait for prey to come to me.

lines.zh: 闲暇时刻，我享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: In my downtime, I enjoy some peace.
Competition with my kind is frequent.
Solitude is the norm; companions are rare.

lines.zh: 这里的食物很少，但我耐心等待。
lines.en: Food is scarce, but I wait patiently.

lines.zh: 等待是最考验耐心的事情。
lines.en: Waiting is the ultimate test of patience.

lines.zh: 同类间的关系复杂微妙。
lines.en: Relationships with my kind are complex.
I lift my head and sniff the sea wind.

lines.zh: 这片岩台够我晒一下午。
lines.en: This rock ledge will do for an afternoon's sun.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔牙缝里的碎肉。
lines.en: I lick shreds of meat from between my teeth.

lines.zh: 岛就这么大，我全记住了。
lines.en: The island is small. I know every part of it.

lines.zh: 你看起来是个不错的猎物。
我注意到了你的一举一动。

lines.en: Both eyes on you — no escape.
I'll be by your side soon.

lines.zh: 我的长腿已经蹬住了地。
lines.en: My long legs are already braced against the ground.

lines.zh: 两只眼朝前，跑起来不拐弯。
lines.en: Both eyes forward—I run without turning.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的两眼之间了。
lines.en: You have stepped between my two eyes.

lines.zh: 我的长腿已经蓄好力了。
lines.en: My long legs are already coiled.

lines.zh: 腿侧裂开，我跑起来打偏。
lines.en: A gash in my flank makes my run swerve.
Come to me, I have food.
I see you, give me meat.

lines.zh: 你这小家伙，给我点吃的！

lines.en: My head can knock you down.
My head, heavy as a mountain.
My head, as hard as iron.
Let me first scent your teeth.

lines.zh: 同岛的，我的气味在这边。
lines.en: Islander, my scent is over here.

lines.zh: 我先闻闻你是不是同类。
lines.en: Let me scent whether you're one of us.
What tasty treat do you hold?
Shield, no match for my might.

lines.zh: 长腿一蹬，岛上没有退路。
lines.en: Long legs push off; no escape on this isle.

lines.zh: 长腿蹬地，我朝你直线去。
lines.en: My long legs push off; I come straight at you.

lines.zh: 我两只眼一起对准你，跑不掉了。
lines.en: Both my eyes are on you — no escape.

lines.zh: 岛屿就这么大，你跑不远。
lines.en: This island is small. You cannot run far.

lines.zh: 风向正好，你的味道过来了。
lines.en: The wind is right. Your scent reaches me.
I chase what moves, not what stands still.

lines.zh: 这一冲可能撞偏，但你会倒下。
lines.en: This charge may miss, but you will still fall.
My jaws are open as far as they go.

lines.zh: 你转身的那刻最好下手。
lines.en: The moment you turn is the best one.
The throat is where I aim.

lines.zh: 长腿一蹬，牙齿已经准备好了。
lines.en: Long legs push off; teeth are ready.
This bite drags the shoulder blade along.
My jaws snap shut on a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的颚，牙就合了。
lines.en: You touch my jaw, and my teeth close.

lines.zh: 我的长腿先冲，牙随后就到。
lines.en: My long legs charge first; the teeth arrive after.
Once I bite, I do not let go!
Your shoulder is in my mouth!
This bite takes the bone along with the meat!

lines.zh: 跑得再快也没我的腿长！
lines.en: Run as you like, your legs are shorter than mine!

lines.zh: 我闻着血味找猎物，长腿先动。
lines.en: I track prey by the smell of blood; these long legs move first.
A shadow in the fossil stone moves.

lines.zh: 阿贝力龙的后代踏上海岸。
lines.en: A descendant of the abelisaurids takes the shore.

lines.zh: 我从培育器里睁开了眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes inside the cultivator.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的岛又有了主人。
lines.en: The Cretaceous island has a master again.
My long legs land and throw up sand.

lines.zh: 我循着蛋壳的裂缝出来。
lines.en: I came out along the crack in the eggshell.

lines.zh: 这声低吼不属于这个时代。
lines.en: This low growl belongs to another age.

lines.zh: 我从泥里站起，抖落水草。
lines.en: I rise from the mud and shake off the weeds.

lines.zh: 火在鳞上烧，我撞进灌木。
lines.en: Fire burns my scales; I crash into the brush.

lines.zh: 岛上猎物太瘦，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: The island's prey is too lean; I am faint with hunger.
